notes.title: 🔫 Xatrom Command arrives on Steam! 🔫
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33027501/854933b12a34545bdbfec535eeed0f5ed85a3ee2.gif[/img]

We're very happy to announce that Xatrom Command has been released on Steam today!

Xatrom Command is a single player or multiplayer top-down shooter!

A top-secret government laboratory experiment went wrong, and now invading aliens have infested the military base.

Time to clean things up! Grab your weapon, recruit a friend, and start blasting wave after wave of alien scum into oblivion.

Play a single player or co-op multiplayer campaign, and have a blast.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
In this update, minor fixes were made such as:

- The language of the Portuguese - Brazil has been inserted

- Correction in the zoom system of the opening cutscene. 

- Fix on unlocking the "Brave explorer" achievement. Now you can unlock without having to collect all 5 secret gems.

- Automatic save game now takes place at two points in the game. 
When leveling up the game is automatically saved to the level selection map. And when returning also to the world map the game is saved. 

- The save game icon has been changed. Every time you view a floppy will mean that the game has been saved.

I will always seek to do my best to bring you a better experience. Have fun!!!

notes.title: Updating Ballon's kingdom.
notes.content:
Hello guys. This week I worked hard to correct some important details for the gameplay. Also, I decided to add a really cool feature that I'll list below for you guys.

1 - This update removed the save slot 2.

2 - A gallery was added that show ideas and several drafts I made during the creation of Bumballon on paper. If you love to know a little more behind the scenes I'm sure you'll really like this feature. 
To have access to the gallery it is necessary to finish the game to unlock.

3 - You can now also change the difficulty of the game by accessing the options menu.

4 - You can now return to the title screen menu by the new quick access buttons. 

5 - A minor correction has been made to the collision of the world's last level Crystal Garden.

6 - In this new update the soundtrack is totally original. In addition the level completion sound effect has also been replaced to match the music of each world. 

7 - A new achievement has been added when you unlock the gallery. 

8 - Improved navigation buttons.

Thank you, everyone. :D
